title: Group 1 melting points
caption: Down group 1 the atoms get larger, so the delocalised electrons are further from the cations and metallic bonding weakens: melting points fall from lithium (181 °C) to caesium (29 °C).
alt: Bar chart of melting points falling down group 1: Li 180.5, Na 97.8, K 63.5, Rb 39.3, Cs 28.5 °C.
